assertions.name: the_markov_parameter_is_convention_D_verified_by_value
assertions.source: ZD matches q^3/(q^2+1) to 0.0 and differs from the convention-C value sqrt(q)/(q+1) by 0.1133677. Verified by VALUE and by source -- _order.ZD is literally Q0**3/(Q0**2+1) -- never by the name, which AGENTS.md records as unreliable here (markovZ spans both conventions; markovZC and markovZc differ by one letter's case and mean opposite things). NOT verified: whether tr_at's coefficient pattern z,z,z^2,z^2,z(hz+1) is itself convention-neutral

assertions.name: the_hecke_cost_is_orthogonal_to_the_radical_reproducing_y0_equals_zero
assertions.source: <t_Hecke, v> = 1.33638e-51, zero to the working precision. This REPRODUCES the corpus's y_0 = 0 (y_0_eq_zero_of_radical, sorry-free; qou-8na1 exact in Q(q)) by an independent route: the cost vector is read off the trace's own definition in the normal-form basis, not taken from the LP literature. Agreement is evidence, not restatement

assertions.name: the_basis_ordering_and_radical_are_validated_by_the_closed_form
assertions.source: <1, v> = -0.12340409412061894061 against the corpus's published closed form -(q-1)(q^2-q+1) = -0.12340409412061894061, agreeing to 1.67048e-51. This is the assertion that validates the BASIS ORDERING: had my nf coordinates been permuted relative to the corpus's operator basis, this pairing would not hit the published value. It also confirms the Lean hypothesis <1, v> != 0 that dual_price_determined_by_radical carries

assertions.name: orthogonality_is_codimension_one_here_not_structural
assertions.source: perturbing ONE coordinate by 1.0e-12 moves the pairing to -1.36755183695e-12, exactly eps*v[0]. So orthogonality to v is a single linear condition on a 6-dimensional space -- a codimension-1 subspace -- and nothing in the construction forces a cost into it. CONTRAST with the block basis, where the Gram is diag(y_lambda*dim_lambda) and the cost t_lambda = y_lambda*f(lambda) carries the SAME factor, so orthogonality is automatic for every f (diagonal_gram_kills_every_cost_on_its_diagonal). The argument that killed the block basis does NOT reach this one

assertions.name: this_is_a_prune_that_does_not_fire_not_a_positive_result
assertions.source: the route is not FORBIDDEN; that is all. No per-operator geometric energy is defined here, because none is in hand -- and writing one to see whether it clears the bar, then keeping it because it did, is selection against the target. The measurement this calibration enables is deliberately left un-run. Recorded as an assertion so the boundary travels with the calibration

description: Calibrates the six-operator-basis machinery against the corpus's known y_0 = 0 result by an INDEPENDENT route -- the Hecke cost vector read straight off tr_at's own formula, against the symbolic Q(q) computation the corpus used -- and then establishes that orthogonality to the radical is codimension-1 on this basis rather than forced by the construction, as it was on the block basis. Invents no energy and runs no LP; the measurement it enables is deliberately left un-run.
